objective: Source-aware coding dictation: understand repository vocabulary, filenames, identifiers, and relevant code relationships while preserving spoken intent.
stage: native source-vocabulary enhancement committed and locally validated

sources.name: SwiftTreeSitter
sources.finding: Swift wrapper for native incremental parsing, language grammars packaged separately. BSD-3-Clause per GitHub metadata. Recommended runtime foundation.

sources.name: Swift grammar
sources.finding: Swift Package exposes TreeSitterSwift C parser.

sources.name: TypeScript grammar
sources.finding: Swift Package exposes TypeScript and TSX parsers; manifest still references legacy ChimeHQ wrapper URL. Resolve package identity/version compatibility before integration.

sources.name: Python grammar
sources.finding: Swift Package exists and references current SwiftTreeSitter URL.

sources.name: Graphify
sources.finding: Installed graphifyy 0.9.32 metadata identifies Apache-2.0 and this repository; GitHub returned 404 during research. Installed extract_swift API tested locally. Do not depend on remote availability or vendor unreviewed updates.

sources.name: Graphify distribution recipe
sources.finding: Current recipe lists Python runtime, NetworkX, Tree-sitter and language grammar dependencies. Useful sidecar; unnecessary runtime burden for native app vocabulary extraction.

sources.name: FluidAudio custom vocabulary
sources.finding: CTC word spotting uses acoustic evidence for vocabulary terms; model-specific integration required. Documentation accuracy/speed figures are upstream claims, not Plynn validation.

sources.name: Universal Ctags
sources.finding: Multi-language tag extraction alternative; additional binary distribution and GPL licensing considerations. macOS /usr/bin/ctags presence does not establish Universal Ctags availability.

sources.name: Language Server Protocol
sources.finding: workspace/symbol supplies symbols when supported by a language server. Requires an editor/server integration; does not establish public access to Codex Desktop active workspace.

recommendation.runtime: Use native SwiftTreeSitter with Swift, TypeScript/TSX, JavaScript and Python grammars. Parse selected workspace in background, cache by content digest, and snapshot context at recording start.
recommendation.graph: Optionally consume validated existing Graphify graph for ranking; require source path/location freshness and distinguish extracted from inferred relationships. Never launch graph/model construction in dictation path.
recommendation.model: Retrieve bounded relevant symbols and declaration context; treat repository material as untrusted data, preserve original intent, and abstain from ambiguous automatic rewrites. Feed both local polish engines through shared prompt contract.
recommendation.recognition: After grounded text-context behavior works, evaluate per-session vocabulary boosting against actual supported ASR engines and recorded audio. Text retrieval alone is not recognition-quality proof.
recommendation.workspace: Reuse explicit Codex Desktop folder selection; never imply automatic active-file discovery without a real integration.

probe.qualification: One offline run on this checkout, not an end-to-end latency benchmark or ASR accuracy measurement.

authority: Local development and experiments only. No commit, push, app replacement, model download, paid request, deployment or merge performed.
baseline_findings: At the upstream baseline, Plynn formatting carried filenames and dictionary spellings, not source-derived vocabulary.
Graphify query against old checkout failed because graphify-out/graph.json was absent.
Graphify per-file Swift extraction yields declarations/imports/references with locations, without a model call.
Unresolved Graphify node IDs can collide across files. Prototype namespaces IDs by source file; cross-file relationships are not inferred.
Graphify entity nodes alone omit argument labels. Direct Tree-sitter identifiers recover preferredSpellings from actual call sites.
Prototype preserves duplicate candidates and only uses explicitly provided active file for ranking.

Source index ignores Git-ignored/untracked excluded sources, hidden paths, selected build folders, symlinks, and files over 256000 bytes. Maximum 500 parsed files. Only structured identifiers and relations leave extractor.
follow_up_options: Audio recognition benchmarks and decoder-level vocabulary boosting.
Automatic editor/workspace integration where public APIs exist.
Graphify-assisted relationship ranking beyond source spelling hints.
